name: Seriema
description: The Seriema is Sami's worn-out fusion-drive ship, which carries the stone across Sothera and into warp.

description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

summary.text: The Seriema is Sami's worn-out fusion-drive ship, which carries the stone across Sothera and into warp.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Sami and Tannuk flew the Seriema to Sigma's Reach, and afterwards Sami woke aboard it with the cask loaded.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

bio.text: On Kavaron the Kav loaded a stasis cask into its cargo bay next to the hotcell holding the Metalman's artifact.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Sami landed it in a slag pool at Taro-duend after a mayday for dying Kav soldiers, and Haliya later found it hidden in a cave and planted charges on it.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

bio.text: It escaped Kavaron with a broken drive, pushed into space by the Guns' boost beams, and was repaired by the Illvoi while drifting.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

bio.text: At Infinite Guideline Pinnacle placed it under tacit arrest, and Sami later drove it at the station to force a game of chicken that opened the eternity column and let it into warp.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Its engine then died and a silence fell over the ship.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

status.text: The last event shows the Seriema in warp with its engine dead and the ship silent.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mirri weftwalks away from Sami and vanishes, and Sami is determined to find her.
timeline.quote: Mirri weftwalked—and vanished.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk aboard the Seriema perform main engine cutoff after their flight plan is rejected by Pinnacle.
timeline.quote: The flight computer stills the main engine.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema braking through Sigma's atmosphere detects a Sunstar palestar warship, which flies off after something else.
timeline.quote: The palestar's taking off toward the other side of Sigma, chasing something else.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema approaches Sigma's Reach from the east at sunset of Sothera's black hole.
timeline.quote: Sothera is now a supervoid, a black hole sun.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami wakes aboard the Seriema under fusion thrust with fuzzy memory, and Tan says Sami fell ill and he loaded the cask aboard.
timeline.quote: I found you in the QA cyst attached to one of the mining sheds.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan notes moxite's value has been sliding everywhere in Sothera though the mine never opened, and they head for Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Like someone opened a new moxite mine here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema narrowly avoids a tumbling kilometer-wide piece of a shattered planet.
timeline.quote: A thousand-gigaton piece of a shattered planet, seven kilometers across and tumbling, flashes past the Seriema at nine kilometers per second.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema flies through the Mordraine Ring toward Kavaron That Is to find a stasis cask for their prize.
timeline.quote: The Seriema plunges stern first through the Mordraine Ring, toward Kavaron That Is and a stasis cask to hold their prize.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami blows up a rock with a beacon to clear a path while Tan flies through the debris.
timeline.quote: I'm gonna blow that chunk into its buddy. You ready?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema and the Hopelight lose sight of each other as the Seriema reenters Kavaron's atmosphere.
timeline.quote: They lose track of the Hopelight behind them as they make reentry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lands the Seriema on a basalt plain, and they set out for the cache.
timeline.quote: Sami sets the Seriema down on a plain of flood basalt

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav load the stasis cask into the Seriema's cargo bay next to the hotcell holding the Metalman's artifact.
timeline.quote: The Kav haul the stasis cask up into the cargo bay and park it next to the hotcell containing the weird rock from Sigma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami broadcasts a mayday to Taro-duend reporting twenty-four Kav soldiers with lethal radiation trauma.
timeline.quote: Twenty-four KMN aboard with lethal radiation trauma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The dying Kav staggered into the Seriema's cargo bay and begged for rescue.
timeline.quote: They had just enough strength left to stagger into the Seriema 's cargo bay and beg for rescue.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Recalling earlier events, Sami notes that Alpharael had a fit when put in the stasis cask with the stone.
timeline.quote: when Sami put the bleeding Monoist in the stasis cask with the rock, the Monoist had a fit.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami discovers a perfect hole in Alpharael's right palm under the medical sleeve.
timeline.quote: they discovered a mystery: a perfect hole in his right palm.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk argues that Alpharael's fusion burn was a disaster, not evil, and cannot be punished.
timeline.quote: You can't avenge a disaster. You can't punish a disaster.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lands in a slag pool at Taro-duend and the pool is drained as Kav rescue crews rush the ship.
timeline.quote: The moment that Sami cuts thrust, someone opens the sluicegate and drains the slag pool.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk puzzle that the Sigma mine never opened yet moxite prices fell.
timeline.quote: That mine never opened.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk volunteers to fetch fuel while Sami investigates Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: So, Tan goes out to buy fuel and reaction mass for the Seriema .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael dreams of his past and his twin Raphaella being chosen for the Plummet, while a voice speaks to him.
timeline.quote: One twin cast into the singularity. One twin turned away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The voice reveals Alpharael has already used it, changing the Hopelight's past so the Kav arrived as walking corpses.
timeline.quote: Alpharael's used me already, to get rid of the Kav.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The voice tells Alpharael why he was meant to wield it.
timeline.quote: Do you understand, Alpharael, why you were meant to wield me?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael wakes strapped in a bunk on the Seriema.
timeline.quote: "I live," he croaks.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael discovers a transparent hole through his right hand.
timeline.quote: A hole right through his hand, palm to dorsum.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael finds Sami's note saying they are out for fuel and he is locked in.
timeline.quote: Gone out for fuel—back soon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael unlocks his cabin hatch by threading a finger through the hole in his hand.
timeline.quote: He drives his left index finger through the hole in his right hand.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael goes to the cargo bay and restarts the stasis cask to retrieve what is inside.
timeline.quote: He rubs at the hole in his hand as the cask whirs up to real time.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: In the third cave she checks, Haliya finds the Seriema.
timeline.quote: In the third cave she checks, she finds a ship called the Seriema

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya plants charges on the Seriema before going in.
timeline.quote: Plant a charge under the Seriema 's folded airfoil.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael tries to wish on the stone for rescue but nothing happens.
timeline.quote: Bring Captain Sami back here safely. Get us off this planet and away from the Sunstar knights.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya enters the cargo bay and Alpharael tries to banish her with the stone.
timeline.quote: Alpharael brandishes the rock at her and shouts, "Vanish!"

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya stuns Alpharael with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: The bright figure shoots him.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya puts a dead-man bomb in Alpharael's mouth to protect herself from the object's influence.
timeline.quote: That's a bomb," she says. "If it doesn't get my passcode every ten seconds, it'll blow up.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya asks Alpharael to use the object to change the past so she was the one he killed, sparing Vondam.
timeline.quote: I need you to change things so that I was the one you killed

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya urges Alpharael to change the past.
timeline.quote: "Do it," she urges him.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya tells Vondam she has Alpharael and offers to be the one the object changed.
timeline.quote: I can be the one it changed. You can be yourself again.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to kill Alpharael and return with the object.
timeline.quote: Haliya, I am ordering you to kill him and return with the object.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya tells Vondam to proceed with protocol seven and fire on her, the object and the Kav.
timeline.quote: You have to fire. Destroy me, the object, and the Kav.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to get out and move to the slag field for extraction.
timeline.quote: Move to the slag field for extraction.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: As a human and a Kav, apparently Sami and Tannuk, reach the Seriema's ramp, Haliya shoots the human through the heart.
timeline.quote: She lases the human through the heart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya kills the grieving Kav, apparently Tannuk, with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: It takes a surprisingly long fraction of a second for her bladiator to burn through the Kav's throat and kill it, too.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael jabs himself with a jet injector and the injection passes through the hole in his hand and into Haliya, paralyzing her.
timeline.quote: Only the injection has gone through his hand, through her armor, and into her .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema's cargo ramp has been lowered by someone who found the ship, and Sami runs for it.
timeline.quote: Someone has found the Seriema , and the prow cargo ramp is down, opening the long jut of the number-one cargo bay to boarding.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lifts the Seriema out of the cave and over the slag field.
timeline.quote: Sami gooses the ship up on a pulse of thrust.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Hopelight lasers off the Seriema's main drive nozzle.
timeline.quote: The main drive! They took out the mag nozzle!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya appears in the cockpit and offers herself as a hostage.
timeline.quote: "Looking for a hostage?" Haliya says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Haliya's armor frees her from the paralytic, and she shocks Alpharael's hands and makes him put the stone in stasis.
timeline.quote: She fries his left hand, too, so he drops the object.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya demands the ship land and puts herself on the distress frequency so Vondam will hear.
timeline.quote: Land this ship. Put me on one-forty-two.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya radios Vondam, claiming she has the object and urging him to stop killing the Kav.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam. Syr Vondam, this is Squire Haliya.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Haliya to kill the crew and force the ship down.
timeline.quote: We'll keep pace until you can kill the crew and force it down.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya urges Vondam to order her death as protocol seven requires.
timeline.quote: We traded places. Now you must order mine!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam refuses to destroy the ship, wanting the object retrieved in stasis.
timeline.quote: We'll retrieve the object and return it to Candela in stasis.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami refuses Alpharael's offer to use the stone to undo the atrocity.
timeline.quote: It didn't work on Sigma, and it won't work here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya begs Vondam to kill her too if the object is worth so much.
timeline.quote: Syr, kill me. If this object is worth so much.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami takes Vondam's silence as permission to escape.
timeline.quote: May I take this as your permission to make my escape?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema lunges up into space.
timeline.quote: The Seriema lunges up into space.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Guns' boost beams push the Seriema's mirrored sail out across the Mordraine Ring into interplanetary space.
timeline.quote: And when their beams converge on the Seriema 's sail, carefully diffused to avoid melting right through it, they push the little ship.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kavaron Memorial Navy swarms Kavaron That Is searching for the authors of the atrocity.
timeline.quote: But by now, every ship in the Kavaron Memorial Navy is swarming out over Kavaron That Is, looking for the authors of the atrocity captured on the Seriema 's cameras.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami declares Alpharael and Haliya guests under mallowmass to stop them fighting.
timeline.quote: Captain Sami declares that all their new passengers are guests under the protection of mallowmass.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya reflects that she can never be a Sunstar knight after the atrocity and her desertion.
timeline.quote: She will never be a Sunstar knight of the Free Company.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
timeline.quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael explain to Sami how they came to Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Together the two of them explain to Captain Sami how they came to Kavaron.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya argues that the Sunstar, not Alpharael, bear responsibility for the dead Kav.
timeline.quote: He's not responsible for the dead Kav at Taro-duend, either. We are.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya concludes that Vondam obeyed the Sum but that the massacre was nonetheless wrong.
timeline.quote: But it was wrong. I know it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya decides the object must be destroyed, and Sami objects.
timeline.quote: We need to destroy the object. It poisons everything.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they are looking for their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: I look for my cat.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami explains that Mirri weftwalked on Uthros and vanished.
timeline.quote: She weftwalked.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya offers to help look for the cat.
timeline.quote: I'll help you look for the cat,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami insists the stone will be given to the Metalman rather than destroyed.
timeline.quote: We're giving it to the Metalman.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells them the Metalman is a wizard.
timeline.quote: I told you. He's a wizard .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya takes a defensive position and resolves to stop Alpharael from taking the ship or using the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Her goal is to prevent Alpharael from taking the ship or using the object.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya rejects destroying the rock because it would violate mallowmass.
timeline.quote: But that would violate mallowmass.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya summons Alpharael to meet with her.
timeline.quote: Eventually, the Summist calls Alpharael to meet with her.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya proposes a détente with Alpharael.
timeline.quote: "We must reach an accord," she says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya says the Sum told her to kill everyone aboard and herself, but she did not.
timeline.quote: Only the Sum says that I was supposed to kill everyone on this ship, including myself.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya calls Alpharael an apostate and offers to take up his case.
timeline.quote: "So, you're an apostate," she says happily.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she will argue that Slats rightly granted Alpharael mercy.
timeline.quote: I'll beg your pardon, and that means I have no duty to kill you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya takes off her helmet and says the Free Company's armor is no longer hers.
timeline.quote: Haliya takes her helmet off, moving so sharply that Alpharael flinches away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael gives Haliya a bottle of cleaning solute.
timeline.quote: I got you a present, by the way.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami announces over the intercom that the Metalman has arrived and prefers the name Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Metalman's here. Come out and present yourselves, or he'll present you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret enters the Seriema from his black engineless ship.
timeline.quote: He pushes into the Seriema with the calm of a prybar.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret questions Haliya about her armor.
timeline.quote: "You wear a wealth of metal," he says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret is delighted that Alpharael fled his creed to live.
timeline.quote: I wanted to live a little longer.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret studies Tannuk, remarking on Llanowar and the power he is afraid of.
timeline.quote: So far from Llanowar … such power in the form.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret greets Sami as the protector of strays and asks for his prize.
timeline.quote: Sami, the generous. Sami, the charitable. Sami, the protector of strays.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells Tezzeret the stone changes the past, as with the vanished miners of Sigma.
timeline.quote: Change the past to suit its purposes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret laughs at Haliya's objection to counterfeit memories.
timeline.quote: Listen to her! Counterfeit memories, an atrocity.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he will see the stone now.
timeline.quote: You're keeping it in your hold. I'll see it now.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she cannot let Tezzeret take the object.
timeline.quote: "I can't let you take the object," Haliya says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he arranged events so the stone would choose him as its conduit.
timeline.quote: I have arranged all this so it will choose me as its conduit.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls the stone the Endstone, as Alpharael's people name it.
timeline.quote: It's what your people call it. Isn't it, boy? The stone from the end.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret declares he will never serve again and wants nothing from the Endstone.
timeline.quote: I won't flee to a better world. I'll stand and face whoever would rule me.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Endstone was made and buried and he will follow it to its maker.
timeline.quote: I must know who made it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret explains he has made himself the shortest path to ground for the Endstone, like lightning.
timeline.quote: I have made myself the shortest path for the Endstone to reach its maker.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret silently forces Haliya's armor to close on her.
timeline.quote: her armor ripples like porridge and closes on her.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret releases Haliya, who drifts limp, and moves to consult the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Haliya drifts away spinning, limbs limp.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret drops a crystal over a map of Sothera and it rolls to a libratory point near Uthros.
timeline.quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reads the crystal's result as Uthros and says he will alert Mm'menon.
timeline.quote: Uthros. The stone wants to go to Uthros.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Free Company search radar sweeps toward the drifting Seriema.
timeline.quote: Search radar howls across the dark.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Free Company radar is abruptly jammed by an unseen attacker.
timeline.quote: The Free Company radar abruptly shuts off.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk admits he is lying to Sami to protect them, but it is too late.
timeline.quote: "It's that kind of lie," Tannuk says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals their real plan is to ask Pinnacle, the Free Company and the Monoists for help.
timeline.quote: Sami's plan is to ask for help.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami promises to return for Mirri.
timeline.quote: I won't be leaving Mirri behind. I'll come back for her.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says he wants to use the stone so his sister never took the Plummet.
timeline.quote: I want to use it so that my sister never took the Plummet.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: An Illvoi ship arrives beside the Seriema.
timeline.quote: A ship appears beside them.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Illvoi extend a superfluid helium bubble around the Seriema.
timeline.quote: they snug their ship up close and extend their helium bubble around Sami's ship.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Illvoi mechans cool the Seriema and begin repairing its fusion drive.
timeline.quote: Then the mechans swarm over the Seriema 's stern to repair the fusion drive.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon introduces themself and asks to come aboard.
timeline.quote: I am Mm'menon. May I come aboard your home?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon explains they were expelled from the Uthros Combine and deduced a causality manipulator.
timeline.quote: I was thrown out of the Uthros Combine

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon says the Endstone is one of many anomalies in Sothera.
timeline.quote: "The Endstone is one of many anomalies," Mm'menon says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret plans to sell the Endstone to its maker, using Mm'menon's ship to boost the Seriema to Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: We will take the Endstone there, and I will sell it to its maker in exchange for a glimpse of their power.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he will not be changed by any hand but his own.
timeline.quote: I will not be changed by any hand except my own.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret assigns Mm'menon to provide stealthy speed.
timeline.quote: Your role, Mm'menon, is to provide us with stealthy speed.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is saving his own ship in case he must abandon the others.
timeline.quote: You're saving it in case you need to abandon the rest of us to die.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami threatens to blow up the ship rather than let Tezzeret harm Haliya, invoking mallowmass.
timeline.quote: "I will detonate this ship if I have to," Sami says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Sami nothing is sacred, only useful, and challenges Sami to prove guest right is useful.
timeline.quote: Nothing's sacred. Only useful.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lays out a plan for Haliya and Alpharael to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline's docking arms.
timeline.quote: Haliya and Alpharael will use armor to leap from the Seriema to one of the harbormaster modules at the end of Infinite Guideline's docking arms.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya agrees to send the message, saying she will carry out her duty to report to Vondam and beg pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: All I can do is carry out my next duty. To return to Vondam, make my report, and beg pardon for Alpharael.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she will not become someone who kills innocents in their homes.
timeline.quote: I don't want to be someone who kills innocents in their homes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says he will go where the stone goes because it has kept him alive.
timeline.quote: I want to live. The stone's kept me alive.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk says he goes only because he has no choice and fears the rock.
timeline.quote: "I'm going 'cause I have no choice," he says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema falls toward Infinite Guideline at fifty kilometers a second.
timeline.quote: They are falling toward the Infinite Guideline , glittering all alone in the dark, at a handsome fifty kilometers a second.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya agonizes over broadcasting and reveals she planted two bombs on the ship.
timeline.quote: I have two bombs on the ship,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael persuades Haliya to keep her word and make the broadcast.
timeline.quote: Maybe you aren't cut out to be a Sunstar knight, Haliya. Maybe you aren't cut out to be certain of everything.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk reveals the crew had already found and thrown out Haliya's bombs.
timeline.quote: We found them while the Illvoi were refitting the fusion engine and threw them out.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command and offers the artifact on Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: I have detached myself from Syr Vondam's command and placed myself on errantry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The fighting continues around but does not touch the Seriema.
timeline.quote: But the fighting does not touch the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami says their plan with Pinnacle is to tell the whole truth.
timeline.quote: So, I'm going to tell them the truth. All of it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they were kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker, which went to the voices in the Wurmwall and mostly did not return.
timeline.quote: I was kitchen help. Not a lot of people came back.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema reaches Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: They make it to Infinite Guideline .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle places the Seriema under tacit arrest.
timeline.quote: The Seriema is under tacit arrest.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Monoist gravkill paladin has taken the Seriema.
timeline.quote: The worshippers of INEVITA have taken the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under warship scrutiny.
timeline.quote: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under the terrifying scrutiny of warships.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami opens the stasis cask and Mirri trots out beside the Endstone.
timeline.quote: A cat trots out of the dark.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael drops the crystal on the map and it settles at the edge of the rag and the system.
timeline.quote: It bounces twice and settles on the very edge of the reading rag, and the solar system, too.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says they will warp until the stone says it has reached its goal.
timeline.quote: We will see what god or monster made this thing.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the warp ferry is in a cherazad and the fleet will kill them as they prepare to warp.
timeline.quote: We can't leave the bubble! The Free Company fleet will kill us the moment we prepare to warp.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Solar Knights board from the dock.
timeline.quote: "Solar Knights outside!" Haliya calls.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami jerks the Seriema free and drives at Infinite Guideline to force a game of chicken.
timeline.quote: With a drumbeat of thruster fire, they jerk the Seriema free of the mooring.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The eternity column opens, letting the Seriema into warp.
timeline.quote: Key meets lock. Eternity opens.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret toasts the success of taking a piece of the unknown.
timeline.quote: We have taken a piece of the unknown.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami realizes the Endstone is steering them toward the Wurmwall.
timeline.quote: They're headed toward the edge of Sothera—the Wurmwall.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Endstone changes into a black ovoid and points at Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The stone has lost its glistening facets. It is now a gleamingly black ovoid.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret explains he sent the most disposable of his workers to Sigma so the stone could choose them.
timeline.quote: I chose the most desperate, disposable pawns in my employ.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk recounts that he met Sami on the wreck of the Wurm Speaker after leaving Kavaron.
timeline.quote: That's where I met Captain Sami.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says they are heading to the place that killed the Wurm Speaker.
timeline.quote: They are saying we are going to the place that killed it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema's engine dies and a silence falls over the ship.
timeline.quote: "The engine!" Tannuk says. "The engine's out!"

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A beautiful creature steps out of a split in the cosmos into the galley.
timeline.quote: A beautiful, beautiful creature steps through.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Endstone falls into the visitor's hand after Alpharael drops it.
timeline.quote: The Endstone falls into its hand.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The visitor says Alpharael is touched by the core and he collapses unconscious.
timeline.quote: Touched by the core. Blessed …

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya's bladiator cuts two of the visitor's fingers and the visitor crushes her throat.
timeline.quote: Haliya's blade goes through two of its fingers.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The visitor declares itself the last thing.
timeline.quote: "I am the last thing," the beautiful android says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The visitor tells Sami the serpent needs a hero and to find it if they can.
timeline.quote: But the serpent needs a hero. Find me if you can.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The visitor vanishes, taking the Endstone with it.
timeline.quote: But stars and nebulae close before it, and it is gone. Just gone. The Endstone with it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret keeps the severed fingers, inhales their violet light and remarks that Sami has something like a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: So. You do have something like a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami holds Mirri, relieved that one thing is all right.
timeline.quote: Mirri is still here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: As a favor to Tezzeret, Sami and Tannuk travel with the Seriema to Sigma's Reach and retrieve the Endstone.
timeline.quote: As a favor to Tezzeret, Sami and Tannuk traveled with the Seriema to Sigma's Reach to find the artifact.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Seriema docks with Tezzeret's ship, where he wants to see what the Endstone will influence them to do; it leads them to Infinite Guideline Station.
timeline.quote: Random chance revealed to them that it wanted to go to Infinite Guideline Station

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Monoists, Summists and Eldrazi converge on the station for the stone; the crew uses the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.
timeline.quote: but they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Vaar android steps out of a hole in space in the Seriema's galley and reclaims the Endstone, fulfilling its desire.
timeline.quote: a Vaar android stepped out to reclaim the Endstone, fulfilling its desire.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya boards the Seriema and kills Sami and Tannuk before Alpharael sedates her; the Endstone revises the timeline so they were only knocked out.
timeline.quote: she killed Sami and Tannuk before Alpharael sedated her

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami buys the Seriema.
timeline.quote: Sami later bought a ship of their own, called the Seriema .

citation.text: "Sami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Sami is captain of the Seriema.
relations.quote: I'm Captain Sami, and my friend is Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

relations.quote: the captain and engineer of the Seriema

citation.text: "Sami". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Sami's worn-out fusion-drive ship, rancid with neutron rot and metal fatigue, with radiator-wings and an aurora aerobrake.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's old fusion ship, now flying with a cask carrying the stone.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's ship, with a plasma magnet, an onboard viy and a mass driver called the sling.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's ship, which carries the stolen stone in a hotcell and lands at Taro-duend.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's ship, hidden in a cave off the slag fields, where Alpharael wakes and where Haliya finds him.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's ship, which escapes Kavaron with a broken fusion drive using a puller sail pushed by the Guns of Kavaron.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's disabled ship, drifting near Kavaron and repaired by the Illvoi.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's ship, which is placed under tacit arrest at Infinite Guideline.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: Sami's ship, which escapes Sothera through the eternity column with a Pinnacle warp ferry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

pages_say.description: The ship on which Sami and Tannuk travel to Sigma's Reach and carry the Endstone.

citation.text: "Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Ship Haliya boarded to destroy Alpharael.

citation.text: "Haliya". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
